actions.action: Break into the center of the root ball to check for rot vs. dryness
Soak the root ball in a bucket of water for 20-30 minutes, in shade
Make vertical cuts in the root ball, slice off the matted bottom and tease the outer roots loose
Repot into the terracotta pot with cactus mix plus perlite (or potting mix with 40% perlite) at the same depth
Check the top inch of soil and water deeply when dry (every 2-3 days in heat)
Snip fully dead stems back to green growth
In winter in the garage, run the lamp 12-14 hours a day and water much less often

reason: The answer correctly identifies drying out rather than overwatering but blames root-binding instead of the terracotta pot. It explicitly tells the owner to skip plastic and repot into terracotta with an extra-fast-draining mix, which works against the fix that actually worked.
